notes.title: Demo Update 3 - New Resources System + Major Changes
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340149/9214d38366d004f99a8c0102fc15fdd30eadf6a0.jpg"][/img]

We have a larger update for this demo. There are tons of small changes and bug fixes, but also some major changes. Let’s break them down:
[/p][p][b]Resource Drops and Resource Collection[/b]
No more double click madness. The game will now spawn an orb with buttons directly available to choose the resource.
Orbs also do not trigger major notification events but will instead light up the region in which they spawn, in case you missed one. The resource collection now feels much more natural and less annoying.
[/p][p][b]Corruption Points[/b]
Each influence item now also awards a small amount of Corruption Points. You can still buy larger Corruption Point packs, but you will find that you spend less time chasing or purchasing items you do not want.
[/p][p][b]Economy and Economy Influence Items[/b]
There is a new tech tree that enables you to play with the economy and resource items of the game in the influence menu, replacing some of the older and unbalanced economy items.[/p][p]You will also notice that territories award fewer Souls by default and that abilities are now slightly more expensive. This is to enable better pacing of the game. The game has been rebalanced to fit these changes.
[/p][p][b]Ark and Shuttle[/b]
This is mainly cosmetic, but we now have a new 3D model for both the Ark and the space shuttle. The older Ark was a placeholder asset. The shuttles now also follow real orbit trajectories.
[/p][p][b]And more…[/b]
Tons of small fixes, improvements, small UI changes, tutorial updates, and more.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update #2 - Guide + Tutorial + Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p]Hey All,[/p][p]We are listening closely to reviews and feedback and it was clearly indicated that we need to add a better tutorial as well as a better way to explain all the mechanics.[/p][p]We added a “step by step” tutorial in Prologue 1 and Prologue 2 but we kept it very short. However, we also added a full guide explaining all the core mechanics of the game. This guide will also evolve over time.[/p][p][u]Press TAB at any time to access it.[/u][/p][p]Please let us know what you think![/p][p][b]Bonus: Major Bug Fix:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bug where disasters would not cause any damage. Finally, we caught that one![/p][/*][/list][p]If you enjoy the game, please do not forget to leave us a review in the Steam Store! 🙂[/p][p]Happy Doomsday![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340149/43a891c511dfcdb9c546ba619f06a714097ab54e.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update #1 and Dev Logs
notes.content:
[p]Hey All,[/p][p][/p][p]We already did a bunch of updates over the last week for the following issues and features:[/p][p][/p][p][b]What We Fixed/Added:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bug where the game would be stuck at 99% progress and never reach the “win” condition.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where all the menus (Disasters/Territories/etc.) would become “unresponsive”.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Key bindings for Active Abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]Other various/smaller issues.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Potential Bug Still There:[/b][/p][p]
Bug where the Disasters don’t cause any damage. If you encounter this issue, please make sure you have the latest version (uninstall/reinstall) and let us know if you still have the issue.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Next Major Update[/b][/p][p]
We are already working on a full-fledged in-game “Guide” as well as incorporating “Tutorial Steps” in Prologue1 and Prologue2.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for your support and for filling out our feedback forms! We are listening very closely to all feedback forms, reviews, and forum discussions.[/p][p][/p][p]If you enjoy the game, please don’t forget to leave us a review in the Steam Store! 🙂[/p][p][/p][p]Happy Apocalypse.[/p]
